preconditions: No user or console run active; acquire H014 reservation and serial lease only for physical phase.
Fresh actual MAC and idle/radio-off checks, exact formally released app SHA/build and retained rollback image.
Inspect new discovery protocol/config; configure only common group/channel, no neighbor MAC or static routing table.
phases: Start A discovery while B radio is off; save baseline neighbor state and control counters.
Start B later; match actual source MAC/boot and first-seen/bidirectional events at A and B.
Select B from A actual neighbor response, not from pre-recorded destination config; send one distinct UTF8 application payload and match B original bytes and origin/boot/seq.
Stop B radio by an authorized command, without manual USB unplug; retain A observation until bidirectional status expires/ages.
Normally reboot B only after closing its handle; verify new local boot, stale boot removal and confirmed reappearance; at most one distinct post-rejoin payload.
Stop/drain/close all test handles and preserve the previously usable OLED/MID bench state; record final bindings and release lease.
measurements: Host monotonic observation times with original device monotonic timestamps retained separately.
A start, B late start, first seen, first confirmed, radio stop, aging, B reboot and re-confirmation delays.
Counter deltas and actually logged control submit/frame events as available; do not label API polls, TX callbacks or scheduled beacons as RF receptions.
Endpoint unique identity and byte comparison; neighbor detection alone is not delivery.
limitations: Same Windows PC with two real RF boards is not two independent Ubuntu hosts.
Ubuntu physical hotplug/re-enumeration remains unverified without a real Ubuntu host and attached board.
Firmware RX/TX counters are not an RF sniffer or retransmission/airtime measurement.
Group/channel preconfiguration is distinct from pre-recording neighbor MAC addresses.
